title: I blow him out about you, Buck Mulligan said, and then you come along with your lousy leer and your gloomy jesuit jibes.
html_source:
Mulligan bigs up Stephen to Haines hoping to get money out of it- Stephen is paying for the pints at The Ship later.

At the end of the chapter, Stephen leaves Mulligan deciding not to return to the Tower. Despite being a stream of consciousness novel, there are vast areas of unseen dark energy pushing the characters' actions. Stephen’s precise reactions to Buck Mulligan’s jeering and control remain unsaid but are implicitly defined by his actions.
